query: Use optical and SAR images together to identify built-up and water-covered regions.

1. Built-Up Structures: Optical high edge gradients are corroborated by intense SAR double-bounce dihedral corner reflections (2.2% joint area).

3. Complementary Advantage: SAR confirms physical surface roughness and vertical elevation facades while Optical delivers material spectral discrimination.
